name: Drill ghost-kick bounce
desc: UK drill kit built on the tresillo 3-3-2 kick with a euclidean ghost-kick layer that walks around the bar, skippy hats, and snare drags punctuating 8-bar phrases.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.25).gain(${gain}*.9), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").room(sine.range(.2,.45).slow(32)).gain(${gain}*.65), s("hh ~ ~ hh ~ ~ hh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.24).mask("<1 1 0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.3).gain(${gain}), s("bd(3,8,<2 4 6 0>)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${ghost}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").room(.3).gain(${gain}*.7).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("hh ~ [hh hh] hh ~ hh [hh hh] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.4 .26 .36 .3]*2").lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.7, ${bright}*1.3).slow(32)).fast(${rate})).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("bd(5,16,<0 3 6 9>)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${ghost}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ [~ sd]").bank("RolandTR808").room(.25).gain(${gain}*.75).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("{hh hh oh hh hh}%8").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.42 .3 .38 .28]*2").lpf(sine.range(${bright}, ${bright}*1.6).slow(16)).fast(${rate})).orbit(1).play()
